description: Gesture on/off switch by voice/text on the drone's Jetson Orin Nano. Gemma 4 E2B (Q4_0 GGUF), greedy decoding with a JSON-schema grammar, prompt clock fixed, 3 fresh-process runs per variant in alternating order, vision stream off. parse_ms = wall time of one parse call. B's enable_hands/disable_hands are reported under the new names. switch = the 20 on/off cases; other_command = commands outside them. Model output text is not included.

platform.board: Jetson Orin Nano 8 GB developer kit

variants.B: status-fields prompt as adopted 2026-11-15; enable_hands/disable_hands with no rule
variants.G: B with enable_gestures/disable_gestures, one rule and one example (adopted, criterion 1 waived by the user)

experiments.per_case_note: action and readings answered from run 1; identical in all 3 runs of each variant
